Objective: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
IntendedChange: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program and securing his financial lifeline, while confronting the final bureaucratic hurdle of the trial.
ProhibitedPatterns: Do not depict Adrian signing the document, Dr. Thorne confirming completion, or Adrian leaving the clinic in any scene prior to the final scene.
Do not resolve the Short arc by having Adrian leave the clinic or fully settle his financial status before the final scene.
Do not introduce the catastrophic accident, nanites, or Lena Reyes.
Do not have Dr. Thorne offer emotional support, financial advice, or break clinical boundaries.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian arrives at the clinic for his third daily visit, physically weakened by the medication's side effects and the previous night's diner shift, and waits in the intake office while Dr. Thorne reviews his compliance logs.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian is seated in the waiting area, physically present but exhausted, having just checked in with the receptionist and waiting for Dr. Thorne to call him into Room 4.

Scenes.Purpose: Dr. Thorne presents the emergency-intervention authorization to Adrian, explaining that it is the final requirement for full enrollment and that it grants the research team permission to use experimental, unapproved treatments (including nanites) in the event of a life-threatening emergency, forcing Adrian to weigh his autonomy against his financial survival.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian is holding the unsigned emergency-intervention authorization document, having just heard Dr. Thorne's clinical explanation of its terms and the consequences of refusal, and is now deciding whether to sign.

Scenes.Purpose: Adrian signs the emergency-intervention authorization, completing his enrollment in the experimental-medicine program, and Dr. Thorne confirms his status as a fully enrolled participant, securing his financial lifeline and concluding the immediate bureaucratic hurdle.
Scenes.IntendedChange: Adrian has signed the document, Dr. Thorne has confirmed his enrollment is complete and his benefits are active, and Adrian is leaving the clinic with his financial survival secured and the final cost of his participation confronted.
